description: Unit test class for KafkaPublishTarget, testing topic extraction, key and partition handling, invalid input cases, immutability, and equality semantics.

methods.description: Tests extraction of topic and key from address.

methods.description: Tests extraction of topic and key containing special characters.

methods.name: extractsTopicAndPartition
methods.description: Tests extraction of topic and partition number.

methods.description: Tests behavior when key is missing after separator.
